headline: Council to hold hearings on National Grid pole and conduit petitions on Pearl Street and Lynn Street, and vote on budget transfers and zoning changes.
summary: The meeting covers public hearings on National Grid petitions for poles and underground conduits on Pearl Street and Lynn Street, budget transfer orders, zoning and ordinance changes including inclusionary zoning and snow storage rules, committee reports on licenses and appointments, and an executive session on a legal matter involving a city employee.
